explication: PR-AF is an AgentField-based, adaptive pull-request reviewer. A review enters through the review endpoint or GitHub webhook, obtains PR and repository context, analyzes the change, creates tailored review dimensions, and runs focused reviews. Findings are grounded in code evidence, challenged by falsifiability gates, clustered for compound-risk synthesis, and coverage-checked before output as a result or GitHub review. The graph reflects README-described capabilities and sampled entry-point, orchestration, GitHub, diff, and HITL code; several phase-to-module links are omitted where wiring was not sampled.
